title: Two Gauss–Green pairs have equal pairings with every continuous compactly supported field in U
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N open, E ⊆ ℝ^N any set, and let (μ, ν) and (μ', ν') be Gauss–Green pairs for (U, E) (IsGaussGreenPair). Then ∫⟨g(x), ν(x)⟩ dμ(x) = ∫⟨g(x), ν'(x)⟩ dμ'(x) for every continuous g : ℝ^N → ℝ^N with compact support and tsupport g ⊆ U.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U E : Set (Rn N)) (μ μ' : Measure (Rn N)) (ν ν' : Rn N → Rn N), IsOpen U → IsGaussGreenPair U E μ ν → IsGaussGreenPair U E μ' ν' → ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → ∫ x, inner ℝ (g x) (ν x) ∂μ = ∫ x, inner ℝ (g x) (ν' x) ∂μ'
